name: Heimbach (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of white, black and white with a broad black middle stripe, charged at the centre with the city arms of Heimbach (a white castle with a small shield on white and red).
history: The small shield in the arms recalls a branch of the family that lived at Schmidt, a former village of Hengebach castle, until 1749.

features.role: Heimbach arms — castle with small shield
